Your mission will be to position innovative HVAC and building services solutions within large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure projects. Working closely with customers, engineering teams, and product specialists, you will translate complex technical requirements into effective solutions. You will also contribute to European sales strategies, technical training initiatives, and industry events. This is an exciting opportunity to influence the development of critical infrastructure projects within a dynamic, international, and technically driven environment. Support and drive the implementation of the European OEM data centre sales strategy, ensuring alignment with broader commercial objectives. Act as the technical and commercial lead for complex data centre projects across multiple European regions. Provide technical support and value-added services, including design reviews, schematic assessments, technical mark-ups, and product integration recommendations. Collaborate with clients, developers, OEMs, consultants, and other stakeholders to develop product specifications and ensure solutions meet project requirements. Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, and training sessions, including accredited Continuing Professional Development (CPD) courses for internal teams and customers. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with a practical and fact-based approach. Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. Highly organised, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary and international teams. Benefits Remote working opportunity with a European scope and international exposure. Full-time position offering the opportunity to contribute to major data centre and mission-critical infrastructure projects. Exposure to innovative HVAC, mechanical, and building services technologies within a growing market.
